protocol.name: m4_seed60_79_frozen_magnitude_robustness
protocol.exclusions: original seed order; no replacement; eligible-only denominators
protocol.performance_gate: none; task failures, false alarms, uncertainty, aborts and zero attempts remain measured outcomes
protocol.analysis_unit: matched seed episodes; same 20 seeds reused across magnitudes; no frame-level independence
protocol.pairing: baseline/V1 full traces; V1/V2 identical reset and trace through first intervention, or entire trace without intervention
protocol.limitations: one held-cube task, privileged state, synthetic positive world-Y relocation; drop also resets height; finite 2-20 cm range
protocol.order: normal, ascending shift magnitudes, ascending drop magnitudes; seed; baseline/V1/V2
protocol.seed_selection: new preselected contiguous seeds 60-79; no adaptive selection or replacement
protocol.resume: verify source/protocol/software/environment and raw hashes; continue unstarted slots only; retain errors
protocol.cross_magnitude_control: each baseline reset and pre-injection prefix must exactly match the same-seed normal baseline

derived_float_method: ordered binary64 accumulation reproduces native Python 3.10 aggregates exactly

outcome_definitions.task_success: Frozen shared contact grasp, lift >= 0.05 m, distance <= 0.025 m and five consecutive static observations; final episode outcome.
outcome_definitions.attempt_complete: Recovery controller finished its own phases, including ten hold actions.
outcome_definitions.aborted: Controller entered abort state; independent of final task success.
outcome_definitions.cost: All attempted actions and observed TCP path, including aborted attempts.
outcome_definitions.sample: Twenty common seeds reused across eleven points and three systems; points and dense frames are correlated.
